structured_output.summary: The diff makes String.prototype.toLocaleLowerCase delegate to the existing prototype_to_lower_case with the same this, args and new_target. The pinned spec text for the non-ECMA-402 variant says the method "works exactly the same as toLowerCase", so the delegation matches the spec. The reserved parameters are ignored, as toLowerCase ignores its arguments. The spec-step comments are kept, and no other files are touched. The gate shows 38 new passes with 0 regressions. The two remaining failures are RegExp.prototype.toString not-implemented errors, which is an honest not-implemented path and not in this ticket's scope. I did not inspect prototype_to_lower_case itself, so its correctness rests on the gate's test262 results.
